subject: youtube.review_image_delivery.default
summary: For Studio visual-review images, Dropbox is the default review-delivery channel. GitHub remains the source-of-truth repository for originals, PSDs, manifests, and version history. Review JPEG/PNG previews should be placed in a clearly named Dropbox project folder and shared from there whenever possible because GitHub's media viewer is inconvenient on mobile.

review_asset_format_preference: PNG only when compatibility is verified

source.ref: Owner directive 2026-10-16: use Dropbox for image review and remember it as project delivery method
